summary: Frontend-only regression + feature test for the new modal-based Upload UX on Files page (SFTP storage PREVIEW_sftp). Verified select→progress phase transition, per-file progress rows, completion toast, Done/X buttons and busy gating, drag-drop overlay, and regression flows (search, view toggle, download, create folder). All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: UploadDialog.jsx: initialFiles is captured only on mount via startedRef; correct guard for the drag-drop → progress phase auto-start. OK.
Files.jsx onDragLeave uses e.currentTarget === e.target — this can be flaky when children are present; consider a counter-based approach for robustness, but current behaviour looks correct in tests.
Toast for multi-file upload is fired only once at end (aggregated) — matches spec; individual per-file toasts intentionally suppressed.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_upload_one.txt, TEST_upload_two.txt, TEST_upload_three.txt, TEST_folder in PREVIEW_sftp root.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login lands on /dashboard first — click 'File Browser' sidebar item (get_by_text('File Browser', exact=True)) to reach /files. PREVIEW_sftp is selected by clicking the storage switcher button with has_text='PREVIEW_sftp'. Upload button (data-testid=upload-file-button) opens the modal at select phase (data-testid=upload-dropzone). Selecting files via [data-testid=upload-input] transitions to progress (data-testid=upload-list) and completes with data-testid=upload-done-button visible + sonner toast. Drag over content area shows data-testid=drop-overlay.

test_results.T1_upload_button_opens_select_modal: PASS — dialog+dropzone visible, upload-list absent, close-btn present, dropzone text 'Drag & drop files here / click to browse'
test_results.T2_single_file_upload: PASS — progress phase entered, done button appeared, toast '1 file uploaded successfully', green check rendered, file visible in list
test_results.T3_multi_file_sequential: PASS — 2 rows shown, toast '2 files uploaded successfully', both files in list
test_results.T5_drag_drop_overlay: PASS — data-testid=drop-overlay appears on dragover of the content area
test_results.T6_regression_search_grid_list_download_: PASS — search filter works, grid/list toggle works, download triggered, folder created
